title: The K-hole: find the five senses again
subtitle: Can't tell dream from waking
intro: She lies in the black hole, unable to move. The five senses are spreading apart; click the line that is still there and let the background recognise it.
closing: The five senses come back one by one. The K-hole is still there, but she knows she is still here.

anchors.line: The light is still on. Look at it first.

anchors.text: Heard the low hum of the air conditioner
anchors.line: The sound is low, but it never stops.

anchors.text: Felt the weight of the blanket
anchors.line: The blanket presses on the back of her hand.
The smell is sharp. Not a dream.
